title: Add workflow catalog view
purpose: Make operational workflows discoverable with clear inputs, risk class and expected evidence.
scope: Render workflow list grouped by service, package, content, update, support and ecosystem categories.
Render detail view with input schema, approval requirements, rollback expectations and evidence outputs.
Link workflow detail to launch-intent preview.
acceptance_criteria: Workflow detail shows risk and approval requirements.
Workflow catalog does not create PlanSpec directly except through typed intent preview.
External dependency status is visible and baseline remains local-only.
Workflow outputs identify audit/support evidence paths.
failure_modes: Workflow detail suggests unsafe direct execution.
Catalog omits rollback requirement for host-changing workflows.
External dependency appears mandatory for baseline.
